name: Low-stock alert
purpose: Warns interested shoppers when an item is nearly gone.
trigger: a product's stock falls below a set number (a built-in trigger)

steps.name: Almost gone
steps.job: Shows the item and how few are left. No discount.
steps.subject: Almost gone: the one you looked at

needs: Stock levels synced from the store platform.
why: Honest scarcity. It only sends when stock is truly low.
